method.selection: Ethereum and Arbitrum hashes came from Blockscout pages of transactions sent by the admin account, from 21 September 15:00 UTC to 14 October 2026, filtered to vault, manager, registry and oracle calls plus one contract creation. The dynMainUSDC deposit, the dynBaseUSDCv4 whitelist grant, deposits and withdrawals came from Blockscout token-transfer and address pages. The BNB transactions were found in the change blocks located by binary search over archived governance() reads.
method.verification: Each transaction, receipt and block timestamp was read from the listed RPC. Inputs and logs were decoded with hand-written ABI fragments; logs that do not match a fragment are kept raw.
limitations: Blockscout listings are bounded pages, not complete chain scans.
No BNB address history was scanned; SFI_3XPL_TOKEN was unavailable.
Admin transactions unrelated to the DynaVaults, such as staking rewards, token transfers and bridging, are excluded.
